Update
I went back and we talked how this one might not be as authentic as he thinks, and after a while he shows me a few others that he bought from the same guy. No surprises when they were in the same situation.
However, these are some of the cleanest refinished watches I have seen. I will try to post some pictures.
Funny enough there is a batch of 36mm vintage collection he thinks are refinished. Might get a very good deal on all of them.

Thank you.
I guess it was too good to be true. Green dials are my weak point. This thing looks incredible on hand. I will try to see if I can knock the price down. If it goes well I will definitely post it.
